in_marathi.name: Satvir
in_marathi.long_meaning: Satvir हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Satvir is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sat' meaning truth, and 'Vir' meaning hero or brave. Satvir is a name that signifies the qualities of truthfulness and courage in an individual. It suggests that the person named Satvir is someone who is strong, brave, and committed to the truth.
